caption: The drawing depicts two views of a brown ceramic jug. The main object is a large, rounded jug with a single handle on the right side and a wide spout on the left. The upper half of the jug is decorated with yellowish-green wavy lines, dots, and patterns, including a leafy design and a triangular area filled with circular spots. The surface of the jug transitions from a darker brown with decorative elements on the upper portion to a lighter brown, undecorated area on the lower portion. Above the jug, there is a smaller, separate depiction of the jug's top view, showing the same brown color with yellowish patterns, and a date, “1827,” inscribed on it. The background is an unadorned light beige color.
title: Pa. German Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
